scope_method: Fresh queue contains five evidence-found atomic claims on the highest-priority next exact candidate; one model, five gaps.
allowed_work: One evidence-only Luna worker may inspect only the five attempts, their accepted source records, and the exact candidate. Verify exact model/build attribution and whether every claim and caveat is already represented. Recommend source-reuse only where supported. Preserve the 8.1 kg independent size-L measurement versus unsupported-basis 7.5 kg regional claim as a conflict; do not revise weight. Keep maximum tire clearance and current seller/warranty unknowns open. No browsing, edits, sibling models, or out-of-scope files.
done_criteria: All five attempts receive an evidence-path-backed source-reuse or unresolved recommendation.
Primary writer integrates only supported ledger resolutions; no candidate value changes unless the scoped evidence proves the exact claim without contradiction.
Fresh data:gaps and research:queue quantify post-batch status.
Run validate, research:check, monotonic coverage acceptance/check and git diff --check; no full gate or image report unless catalog/source/image records change.
